title: NVAPI unavailable
hint: dxvk-nvapi did not initialise. Needs PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI=1 (Proton) / DXVK_ENABLE_NVAPI=1 and an NVIDIA GPU that is not hidden (Linter: nvapi-hidden).

title: nvcuda.dll missing
hint: CUDA/PhysX path: enable NVAPI/NVIDIA libs in Proton (PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI, PROTON_NVIDIA_LIBS).

title: GPU device lost (hang/reset)
hint: Often an unstable GPU overclock/undervolt or driver fault: test at stock clocks and a default V/F curve.

title: Out of memory
hint: VRAM or RAM exhausted: lower textures/resolution; DXVK_CONFIG dxgi.maxDeviceMemory caps reported VRAM.

title: ntsync not usable
hint: Kernel module not loaded (modprobe ntsync / CONFIG_NTSYNC) — or unset PROTON_USE_NTSYNC (Linter: ntsync-missing).

title: esync/fsync file-descriptor limit
hint: Raise the nofile hard limit (≥ 524288) in limits.conf / the service, or set PROTON_NO_ESYNC=1.

title: Vulkan device/instance creation failed
hint: Driver/ICD problem: check the System tab (vulkaninfo), DXVK_FILTER_DEVICE_NAME and the PRIME offload variables.

title: Missing Vulkan extension/feature
hint: Driver too old for this DXVK/vkd3d-proton build: update the driver or use an older build (DLL Manager).

title: NGX / DLSS failed to load
hint: Check the DLL Manager tab and PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI=1; a mismatching nvngx_dlss.dll in the game folder also causes this.

title: Missing DLL import
hint: A required runtime DLL is absent in the prefix (VC++ redistributables, d3dcompiler_47, xinput …).
